routines.semantics: Adds corresponding Cartesian components of two length-three vectors without normalizing them.

scenarios.observes: vadd adds vectors componentwise with mixed signs; the raw return reaches StepOutput.value and is recursively compared including vector length/order. No harness substitute.

routines.errorAssessment: NAIF documents this routine as error-free for finite, correctly shaped inputs. No artificial CSPICE error case is warranted; invalid JS shape/type validation is wrapper behavior rather than a live numeric CSPICE parity claim. Overflow is outside this finite-output fixture set; no global tolerance relaxation.
routines.fixtureRationale: No kernels/files required. Mathematical inputs authored in this batch, with no external scientific data or redistribution dependency.
routines.cleanup: No kernel, handle, or file is acquired. WASM helper frees its allocated input/output/error buffers in finally; native copies stack arrays and serializes CSPICE calls. Each parity workflow clears/reset state and the test disposes the backend in finally; the Python process runs finalizers then kclear/reset.
routines.tolerance: Existing 1e-12 absolute-or-relative comparison is adequate for these nonzero outputs (order-one/fractional components and large finite magnitudes). Zero-vector/cancellation results are compared componentwise; signed zero is numerically equivalent. Small-magnitude vhat inputs produce order-one unit vectors, avoiding a meaningless sub-tolerance output comparison.
